patthana16.81:1.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana16.81:2.1: anidassanaappaṭighaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi. sanidassanattika savitakkaduke nasanidassanattika nasavitakkadukaṃ
